target_pest_or_disease: Leaf Blast, Neck Blast, Node Blast (Pyricularia oryzae)
purpose: Systemic protective and curative fungicide inhibiting melanin biosynthesis
toxicity_label_triangle: Yellow (Highly Toxic) / Blue (Moderately Toxic as per formulation)
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 300-400 g/ha (0.6g/L water). Apply at first sign of blast and repeat at boot leaf / panicle emergence.
safety_information: Wear protective clothing and gloves; do not spray against the wind; poisonous to fish and aquatic fauna; avoid skin contact.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved for Rice blast under CIBRC Major Uses. Note: Export rice to EU subject to strict 0.01 mg/kg MRL restrictions.
source: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (DPPQS) CIBRC Major Uses
region: All India (Major use in AP, TN, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala)

target_pest_or_disease: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani), Powdery Mildew, Tikka leaf spot
purpose: Broad-spectrum systemic triazole fungicide with protective and curative action
waiting_period_phi_days: 30 days for rice, 40 days for mango
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 1000 ml/ha (2ml/L water). Direct spray to the base of tillers where sheath lesions originate.
safety_information: Harmful if swallowed or absorbed through skin; keep away from animal feed and water bodies; wash thoroughly after handling.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved for Rice sheath blight under CIBRC. Follow prescribed pre-harvest interval.

target_crop: Paddy / Rice, Tomato, Cotton, Sugarcane, Maize, Chilli
target_pest_or_disease: Yellow Stem Borer, Leaf Folder, Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa), American Bollworm, Early Shoot Borer, Fall Armyworm
purpose: Anthranilic diamide insecticide activating ryanodine receptor channels in insect muscle cells causing feeding cessation and paralysis
toxicity_label_triangle: Green (Slightly Toxic - High mammalian safety margin)
waiting_period_phi_days: Rice: 47 days; Tomato: 3 days; Cotton: 9 days; Sugarcane: 200 days; Chilli: 3 days
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 150 ml/ha (0.3ml/L water) for tomato/rice/chilli; 200 ml/ha for sugarcane early shoot borer. Target early instar larvae.
safety_information: Very safe to non-target predatory beneficials, spiders, and bees when applied at recommended rates. Dispose of empty containers safely.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved for stem borers, bollworms, and fruit borers across major field and vegetable crops under CIBRC.
region: All India (Widely utilized in Karnataka, AP, Telangana, TN)

target_crop: Tomato, Chilli, Paddy, Potato, Groundnut, Grapes
target_pest_or_disease: Early Blight, Late Blight, Anthracnose, Fruit Rot, Brown Spot, Tikka spot
purpose: Broad-spectrum contact protective dithiocarbamate fungicide with multi-site activity
waiting_period_phi_days: Tomato: 3-5 days; Chilli: 7 days; Paddy: 15 days
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 1.5 - 2.0 kg/ha (2.0 - 2.5 g/L water). Apply as prophylactic spray prior to rain or immediately upon first lesion detection.
safety_information: Irritating to eyes, respiratory system and skin; wear protective goggles and mask; toxic to fish.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved broad-spectrum fungicide under Insecticides Act 1968.
source: DPPQS CIBRC Major Uses of Fungicides

target_pest_or_disease: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci), Thrips, Yellow Mites, Diamondback Moth
purpose: Pro-insecticide activated by sunlight/enzymes to carbodiimide; inhibits mitochondrial ATP synthase
waiting_period_phi_days: Cotton: 30 days; Chilli: 7 days; Tomato: 5 days
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 600 g/ha (1.2g/L water). Apply when sunshine is bright for maximum photolytic activation.
safety_information: Avoid inhalation of spray mist; wear protective clothing; toxic to aquatic organisms and bees if directly sprayed on open blooms.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved for sucking pest management in cotton and solanaceous vegetables under CIBRC.

target_crop: Coconut, Arecanut, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Coffee, Rubber, Tomato, Cotton
target_pest_or_disease: Bud Rot, Koleroga (Fruit Rot), Quick Wilt (Foot rot), Coffee Rust, Abnormal Leaf Fall, Bacterial Blight
purpose: Inorganic protective broad-spectrum contact fungicide and bactericide releasing cupric ions
application_information: Approved dosage: 2.5 to 3.0 g/L water (or 10% paste for trunk wounds). Essential component of plantation pre-monsoon schedules.
safety_information: Corrosive to metals; rinse spray tank after use; avoid breathing spray dust; do not apply in hot direct mid-day sun to avoid phytotoxicity.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved for agricultural use; widely permitted in integrated crop protection schedules across South India.
source: DPPQS CIBRC Major Uses of Fungicides
region: All India (Vital for Western Ghats plantation tracts)

target_pest_or_disease: Brown Plant Hopper (Nilaparvata lugens), Whitebacked Plant Hopper (Sogatella furcifera)
purpose: Mesoionic insecticide binding to nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR) causing immediate cessation of feeding
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 235 ml/ha (0.48ml/L water). Single application at early hopper threshold (1-2 hoppers/tiller); direct nozzle to base of tillers.
safety_information: Minimal disruption to beneficial natural enemies (spiders, mirid bugs); handle with standard PPE.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved exclusively for rice planthoppers under CIBRC. Observe single application per season resistance management guideline.
region: Rice growing states (Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka)

pesticide_product: Ridomil Gold MZ 68 WG / Krilaxyl MZ 72 WP
formulation: WP / WG (Wettable Powder / Water Dispersible Granule)
target_crop: Tomato, Potato, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Grapes
target_pest_or_disease: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans), Foot Rot (Phytophthora capsici), Azhukal (Phytophthora nicotianae), Downy Mildew
purpose: Dual-action combination of systemic acylalanine (inhibiting fungal ribosomal RNA synthesis) and contact protectant
application_information: Approved CIBRC dosage: 1.5 - 2.0 kg/ha (2.0g/L water). Spray or drench soil around foot rot affected vine collars.
safety_information: Wear rubber gloves and mask during mixing; do not exceed 2-3 consecutive applications to prevent resistance development.
regulatory_restrictions: Approved under CIBRC. Strict resistance management: must alternate with multi-site contact fungicides (Bordeaux mixture/Copper Oxychloride).
source: DPPQS CIBRC Major Uses of Fungicides

application_information: DO NOT APPLY: Endosulfan is completely banned nationwide by the Supreme Court of India. Monocrotophos is banned for use on vegetables and fruit crops under Gazette S.O. 3951(E).
safety_information: Extremely high toxicity to humans, mammals, and aquatic ecology; severe persistence and bioaccumulation.
registration_information: Gazette Notification S.O. 3951(E) & Insecticides Act 1968 Schedule of Banned Pesticides
regulatory_restrictions: STRICTLY PROHIBITED IN KRISHI MARGA: Under no circumstances should these banned chemicals be recommended to farmers.
source: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee Banned List (DPPQS)
